item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This does what it sets out to do, with a good sense of verisimilitude and lots of neat crunchy detail.

I think that "Evolved from Naturally Occurring Gears, Levers and Pulleys" is way way too long for an MTF nickname (ideally you want to be able to use "[nickname]-Actual" for the commanders radio callsign, IMO). It's a cute name for the contest team, but they really ought to have used something snappier for the MTF.
